limitations: Strict canonical task lists and the legacy recovery list remain separate; the legacy path retains backlink/conflict diagnostics. This is not proof that all plugin contracts agree.

Some fixtures directly invoke reference generators with supplied tasks. They now test extraction through a separate native adapter path; those fixtures do not certify task admission.
